Amends title 36, United States Code, to insert a commemorative calendar day and renumber existing sections.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 36, United States Code, to designate July 20 as Lunar Landing Day.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent annual commemorative day recognized nationwide.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill designates July 20 as Lunar Landing Day and encourages public recognition and educational activities. It creates no mandatory programs, funding, or direct economic or legal requirements.
